basic_profile.bio: I am a 24-year-old geography student residing in Syracuse, New York. I'm passionate about gaming, especially mods like Calamity for Terraria. When I'm not gaming, you'll find me browsing subreddits about frogs or engaging in discussions about economic policies. I work part-time at a local bookstore which allows me to indulge in my love for reading, particularly manga like JoJo and Berserk. I usually hop online in the evenings after my classes and work shifts. Currently single, I'm enjoying the freedom to explore different communities and hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My knowledge primarily comes from my academic background in geography and self-study in gaming, particularly modded games. I often follow economic discussions to stay informed about global trends, mostly through online articles and forum debates.
